recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, blue-toned macro image of a human eye serves as the background for a multi-layered typographic composition. The design features a film-strip border, beveled 3D display text, and a structured list of information organized into columns over the iris and sclera.
coreVisualRelationships: Large beveled title overlapping the upper eyelid
Secondary title set against a dark horizontal band
Dual-column list of names and titles centered over the pupil and iris
Film-strip motif framing the top and bottom edges
coreInvariants: Red-to-orange gradient for the primary display text
Horizontal yellow banner for the subtitle
Repetitive 'movie' watermark text in the background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A macro human eye occupies the entire frame, scaled so the pupil is slightly right of center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, red beveled 'CINEMA' text at the top left and center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the red title, moves down to the yellow horizontal bar, then scans the two columns of white text over the blue eye.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The white sclera of the eye provides high-contrast space for the left-hand text column.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cyan-blue photographic tones for the background and textures.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for the body text and list items.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red with orange bevels for the main title; bright yellow for the horizontal banner.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the dark pupil/eyelashes and the bright white sclera; saturated primary colors for titles.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric sans-serif and wide humanist sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses thick, rounded strokes with heavy 3D beveling and inner glows.
Secondary title uses a wide, extended sans-serif with mixed-case height logic.
Body text uses a clean, bold geometric sans-serif for legibility against the complex background.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'i' in the secondary title is scaled to match the height of uppercase letters.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact 3D display face paired with wide, flat geometric sans-serifs for a technical, 'millennium' look.
graphicDevices: Film strip borders with sprocket holes

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, technical feel of the secondary titles.
Provides the geometric foundation for the list items.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A macro, high-contrast cyanotype-blue image of a human eye. Add a black film-strip border at the top and bottom with small white sprocket holes. Include a faint, repeating watermark of the word 'movie' in a small sans-serif font across the center. Place a solid yellow horizontal bar across the middle-left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, red-to-orange beveled 3D title at the top. Place a wide, white sans-serif subtitle on the right. Arrange two columns of white geometric sans-serif text below the yellow bar, one on the left sclera and one over the dark pupil.

verificationChecks: Does the main title have a distinct 3D bevel?
Are there film-strip borders at the top and bottom?
Is the text organized into two distinct columns?

adjustableVariables: Depth of the 3D bevel on the title
Width of the yellow horizontal banner
mustRedesign: Specific artist names and movie titles
Exact kerning of the original brand marks

mustAchieve: High legibility of white text against blue background
Consistent 3D lighting on the main title
avoid: Muddied colors in the eye texture

postGenerationChecks: Check that the red title does not bleed into the blue background.
Ensure the film strip holes are evenly spaced.
Verify the yellow bar is perfectly horizontal.
Confirm the two-column text alignment is clean.
recipe.reuseFormula: Macro Eye Background (Blue) + Film Strip Borders + Beveled Display Title + Two-Column List Layout.
